description: FULL TIER ONLY. Use when you want to stress a strategy (a catalogue slug or an inline rule set) on any ticker. On this free endpoint the call returns the coded error UPGRADE_REQUIRED with how to get a token. Free alternative: challenge_strategy (buy_and_hold, rsi_30_70 across the regime catalogue) or run_stress_test (buy-and-hold on one cached regime).
name: tier2_stress_test
title: Stress a catalogue strategy on any ticker (on-demand)
